what: One three fragment shader is laid on each plate. crt — over the photo, 3px scanlines (.22), a pixel grid (6px, .08), an accent-tinted darkness and an edge darkness are drawn once and it stops (measured, the original curtain does not move either), with the edge darkness added like a CRT monitor. scan — over a base where 1.5% of pixels sparkle, a light bar (width .035, blur .16) travels once per 4s up and down 20~80% of the plate (with warn, accent → warning red). tunnel — on an accent plate, the rings of a rectangular tunnel (width .62 · height .36) and 16 spokes are drawn at 32% text color, the rings flow inward at .08 per second and go 1.5 cells deeper by the scroll passing the plate. spiral — when visible, a rectangular spiral band (14 turns, rotating .2 per second) spreads out from the center in .9s (cubic out) at 22% accent and lies under the card background

options.period: one full up-and-down pass of the scan bar (sec), default 4
options.warn: Ratio 0~1 for blending the scan bar color from the accent color to warning red, default 0 — the ”threat grows” section

use: Photo
note: If three is missing, it loads library/_vendor/three@0.174.0/build/three.cjs by itself and moves it onto window.THREE. Colors are read when attached: --kf-accent, --kf-bg, --kf-ink. The tunnel uses --kf-on-accent lines on a --kf-accent background, and warning red is --fx-warn. Drawing stops when the panel is off-screen. The original bitmap panel carves a real photo into pixels, but this part does not read the photo directly and lays a film over it instead.
